estimate_pointcloud_normals: estimate normals for a PyTorch3D point cloud using a configurable neighborhood size and direction disambiguation
estimate_pointcloud_local_coord_frames: estimate local coordinate frames and curvatures for a point cloud with optional direction disambiguation
Pointclouds_estimate_normals: call the estimate_normals method on a PyTorch3D Pointclouds object to compute and assign normals in place
init_spherical_pcl: generate a random spherical point cloud with known ground truth normals for testing normal estimation
test_pcl_normals: run the unit test that validates point cloud normal estimation against ground truth on spherical data
